title: Parametric maximum closure on precedence forests
summary: The Maximum Closure Problem asks for a maximum-weight closed subset of a precedence-constrained set of vertices; when vertex weights depend affinely on a scalar parameter $λ$, as in open-pit mine scheduling, the goal becomes computing the optimal closed set for every value of $λ$ at once. We address this problem when the precedence graph is a directed forest.
